stories.title: Top 25: Fatal flaws for every College Football Playoff team?
stories.summary: The first rankings are out and are bound to change, but here's how the teams stack up and what could do them in.

stories.title: CFP ranking release: Three things we learned and one question
stories.summary: A conference-by-conference look at which teams are contending for the playoff, who's close and who's out.

stories.title: Agent: Aiyuk files to be reinstated, plans to report to 49ers on Friday
stories.summary: Brandon Aiyuk has turned in paperwork to be reinstated, agent Drew Rosenhaus told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Wednesday.

stories.title: Warriors withholding payments to Porzingis on $20M salary, sources say
stories.summary: The Golden State Warriors are not delivering semimonthly payments to veteran center Kristaps Porzingis on his $20 million salary, league sources told ESPN, ruling that the currently absent center is not rendering his services.

stories.title: Ex-MLB star Teixeira wins U.S. House seat in Texas; Tuberville to be Alabama governor
stories.summary: Republican Mark Teixeira, a three-time Major League Baseball All-Star, has won election to the U.S. House in Texas' 21st Congressional District. Also Tuesday, former college football coach Tommy Tuberville won the Alabama gubernatorial race.
